intro: The Tourmaline Phial is a specialized gem-crafted vessel given to travelers in Teldrassil by Corithras Moonrage. It is used to draw blessed waters from the moonwell beside the Pools of Arlithrien as part of ongoing rituals to monitor and soothe the boughs of the World Tree.

p: Corithras Moonrage provides the Tourmaline Phial to aid in the rituals surrounding the World Tree. The druids in Dolanaar use such dedicated gemstone vials to safely collect pure moonwell waters from across Teldrassil. This particular phial is designated for the moonwell on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien, southeast of the road leading to Darnassus, an area increasingly beleaguered by hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs.
